LESSON: TARAWEEH AND WITR

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2.2: Taraweeh and Witr

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Taraweeh and Witr
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how they perform Taraweeh/witr prayers. What is the significance of performing swalatul Taraweeh and witr?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment
2. appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment

Teach
• Today’s focus: perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment” using a school example.
• Model B for “perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment
• Model 2: appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment
2. Practise: appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Taraweeh and Witr.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how they perform Taraweeh/witr prayers. What is the significance of performing swalatul Taraweeh and witr?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• perform swalatul Taraweeh and witr for spiritual nourishment
• appreciate the performance of Taraweeh and witr prayers to earn thawab
